Subject: North Tower exec roundtable — site & AV plan (load-in, redundancy, bridge)

Hi team,

I pulled together an initial site + AV plan for the exec roundtable with Acme (28 confirmed attendees). Goal is a single-room run (main theater on North Tower, floor 12) with a hybrid bridge for five remote execs. Key asks below — please confirm by EOD so we can lock the venue and start procurement for the dedicated network drop.

High-level:
- Room: North Tower, Theatre A (capacity 40) — adjacent breakout for lunches.
- AV: two camera angles (presenter + audience), tabletop mics for panellists, room PA, hybrid bridge (Zoom Rooms preferred), local laptop for slides, on-site AV tech for full day.
- Redundancy: dual ISP handoff + SRT fallback for live stream; hot spare laptop preloaded with slides; backup 4G router.
- Security: SSO for hosts, restricted guest Wi‑Fi, no attendee recording without permission.

Open questions / asks:
1) Events: can you confirm available A/V inventory and whether they support SRT and hardware H.265?
2) Lauren: any exec-specific layout requests (head table, mics, seating)?
3) Dev: any bridge/network requirements we should pre-provision on the firewall?

Attachments: preliminary room layout and attendee map (I'll attach after Lauren confirms).

Main deliverables if we sign off: load-in window (03/30 07:00–11:00), full tech rehearsal (03/30 14:00–15:00), event day (03/31 08:00–16:00).

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: North Tower exec roundtable — site & AV plan (load-in, redundancy, bridge)

Hi Priyom / Lauren,

Thanks — theatre availability confirmed for March 31. See our AV inventory summary below and a few notes on redundancy. I attached the full AV_inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet) with serials and test dates.

AV inventory highlights:
- 2x PTZ cameras (Sony SRG‑X400) + NDI output, 1x wide static camera
- 6x Shure MXA tabletop mics + 4x lavaliers, Dante audio network enabled
- 1x Crestron/AV control, Poly/Zoom bridging hardware, hardware H.265 encoder (Teradek)
- Local matrix switcher with redundant power supplies

Redundancy options we support:
- Dual ISP: we can provision primary (on-site fiber) + secondary (bonded cable) on the same VLAN; recommend BGP failover if you need <1s cutover.
- SRT stream fallback from local encoder to cloud ingest if Zoom bridge fails.
- Hot spare laptop and pre-synced slides on a network share — we can hold a spare in the rack.

Network / port notes for Dev: we require outbound TCP 443, UDP 3478–3481 for STUN/TURN, and open for SRT on TCP 1935 if you want encoder -> cloud path. We can provide a /29 for temporary devices.

Attachment: AV_inventory.xlsx (file)

Let us know if you want us to reserve the redundant ISP now.

Best,
Clara Reeves
Event Operations Manager
Venue Group

Subject: Re: North Tower exec roundtable — site & AV plan (load-in, redundancy, bridge)

Folks — technical ops notes and checklist for the bridge and network. Forwarding Clara's inventory inlined for context.

Requirements / actions for IT/security:
1) Firewall rules: allow outbound TCP 443, UDP 3478–3481 (STUN/TURN), SRT TCP 1935. If we use Poly cloud PSTN fallback, allow 5061 for SIP TLS.
2) OAuth SSO: add redirect URI for the event controller (https://auth.redwood.inference.com/zoom-callback). Will need the venue to whitelist.
3) Video interoperability: we will connect Zoom Rooms to on-prem Poly hardware via SIP gateway. Recommend hardware H.265 encoder for the stream (Teradek) with SRT to cloud ingest as failover.
4) Test plan: full connectivity test on 03/30 14:00–15:00 (recommended). I will bring a spare laptop and an LTE bridge (Cradlepoint) for last-resort connectivity.

Attachments: room_layout_v3.pdf (attached).

Quoted for context:

—Dev
